items.question: Do the listed prices include VAT?
items.answer: No, plan prices exclude VAT. At the time of payment you receive a regular invoice issued to the school.

items.question: Can I migrate the data I already have in Excel?
items.answer: Yes. You can import students and teachers from CSV/Excel files with the guided procedure, which flags any errors before saving. For special situations our support team walks you through the migration.

items.question: How is student data handled, including minors?
items.answer: InsegnaMi.pro is GDPR compliant and data is hosted on servers in the European Union. The school remains the data controller and we act as processor: data is never sold or used for other purposes.

items.question: Can I cancel whenever I want?
items.answer: Yes, you cancel on your own from the billing dashboard, with no lock-in or penalties. After cancellation your data remains exportable for 30 days.

items.question: What support is included?
items.answer: All plans include email support in Italian. We help you with the initial setup and with everyday questions.

items.question: Do you handle electronic invoicing?
items.answer: The platform is ready for electronic invoicing towards the Italian SDI with XML export of invoices, available from the Professional plan.

items.question: Can I see a demo before signing up?
items.answer: Yes, you can access the online demo with sample data, without registering. Alternatively you can activate the 14-day free trial on your school, with no credit card.

items.question: What's the difference between the plans?
items.answer: All core features (register, attendance, grades, payments, communications and family portal) are included in every plan. Plans differ in student, teacher and class limits and in advanced features such as electronic invoicing, accounting, analytics and automations.

faqs.question: Is the electronic register suitable for a small school too?
faqs.answer: Yes. InsegnaMi.pro is designed for private schools of every size: from the small academy with one class to institutes with dozens of courses. You choose the plan based on the number of students.

faqs.question: Can parents see grades and absences?
faqs.answer: Yes, through the included family portal: each parent logs in with their own credentials and sees their children's grades, attendance, notes and communications. The school decides what to make visible.

faqs.question: Do I need to install anything?
faqs.answer: No. InsegnaMi.pro is a web application: it works from the browser on computers, tablets and smartphones with no installations or servers to manage.

faqs.question: Can I manage different fees for different courses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each course or enrollment can have its own amount and its own installment plan: monthly, quarterly, yearly or custom.

faqs.question: Does InsegnaMi.pro issue electronic invoices?
faqs.answer: InsegnaMi.pro records payments and generates PDF receipts; the data is organized to be passed to your accountant or electronic invoicing software, without retyping it by hand.

faqs.question: How do reminders work?
faqs.answer: You set installment due dates and the system sends automatic email reminders to families with upcoming or overdue payments. You can always see the status of each installment.
